risks.title: China Export Dependency
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central in the 10-K, with strong language on escalating export restrictions since 2020 and the 2022 regulatory framework. Dependence on China for significant revenue share and escalation of US-China trade tensions increase severity. Geopolitical category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Increased Competition in Ion Implantation
risks.score_rationale: Document mentions a dominant competitor and multiple innovative players, with clear risk of downward price pressure and market share loss. Language is repeated and structured, indicating consistent concern. Competition category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Dependence on Few Key Customers
risks.score_rationale: Top 10 customers represent 55.2% of sales in 2025, up from prior years. Absence of long-term agreements and risk of losing a major customer are explicitly highlighted. Risk is reinforced by geographic concentration in Asia.

risks.title: Dependence on External Suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes reliance on limited suppliers for critical components, with risks of shortages, cost increases, and delays. Language is concerned, particularly around manufacturing lead times and lack of alternatives. Industrial category is strongly weighted.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk is documented with precise data (11.4% of revenues in local currencies), but language is measured, focusing on non-cash impacts. South Korea expansion increases exposure, but hedging measures are not mentioned. Capital category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Difficulty Recruiting Qualified Personnel
risks.score_rationale: Risk is mentioned as important, with strong competition for engineers. However, it is not tied to a recent event nor critical situation. Language is cautious. Key Person category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Volatility in Financial Results
risks.score_rationale: Document strongly emphasizes small customer base and high system prices, driving significant quarterly fluctuations. Risk is repeated and illustrated by concrete examples. Capital category is strongly weighted due to potential market impact.
